text: Kingsmoor FC presses on the left flank near Westport Albion’s goal at the north end. They maintain pressure with five entries into the final third over the last eight minutes and create a big chance when Duarte fires off-target towards the centre of goal at 38 minutes [#713]. The score remains 2-2 as Kingsmoor takes control in the attacking third.
